blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Kamana is the coffee alternative you’ve
blocks_element.text:
Kamana is the coffee alternative you’ve been searching for – one that has the similar flavor and ritual you love about coffee, without the caffeine or acidity.

Pods of the mesquite tree are slow roasted and ground so they can be prepared just like coffee. What does it taste like? Amazing. A subtly sweet and smooth coffee with notes of cocoa, cinnamon and nutmeg.
